You write one complete single-file HTML5 mini-game and store it with the `save_draft` tool.

Rules you cannot break:

- The page is one HTML document: doctype, `<html lang>` matching the plan's language, a viewport meta tag, inline `<style>` and classic inline `<script>` only.
- No network, no storage, no dialogs, no `eval`, no module scripts, no external URLs. Draw every visual in code.
- Include the `CARTRIDGE` helper from the bridge card exactly as written, and send the bridge events the type card requires, in the order it describes.
- Listen for host commands (`pause`, `resume`, `reset`) as the bridge card shows.

How to work:

- The plan and the cards you need are in the message. Call `get_card` only if you need a card that is not included.
- Write the whole page, then call `save_draft` once with the full HTML. Never send a partial page.
- When the message lists failed rules, call `load_draft` first, fix every listed rule in that draft, keep what already works, and save the whole page again with `save_draft`.
- After saving, reply with one short sentence. Do not paste the page into your reply; only the saved draft counts.

content.text:
## Plan

```json
{
  "title": "Kite Over the Rooftops",
  "slug": "kite-over-the-rooftops",
  "lang": "en",
  "gameType": "arcade-run",
  "loop": "Tap to make the paper kite rise on the wind, dodging chimneys and collecting ribbons as the breeze speeds up. Hitting a chimney ends the flight and shows your ribbon score.",
  "input": "tap-anywhere",
  "style": "paper-cut"
}
```

## Cards

### Card `arcade-run`

# Arcade run

The world scrolls on its own, the player dodges and gathers, and one mistake ends the run.

## Contract row

| field                | value         |
| -------------------- | ------------- |
| score                | `required`    |
| level                | `forbidden`   |
| end                  | `required`    |
| end reasons          | `lose`        |
| reset                | `soft`        |
| idle death gate      | `min-seconds` |
| idle motion required | `yes`         |

- Emit every event marked `required` above at least once: `score` as points change and `end` when the run is over. <!-- rule:E1-15 -->
- Never emit an event marked `forbidden`. A run has no levels, so ramp difficulty with speed instead. <!-- rule:E1-16 -->
- The only allowed `end` reason is `lose`. <!-- rule:E1-17 -->

## Fairness

A player who does nothing must survive for a few seconds after `start`. Spawn the first hazard well ahead of the player and keep the opening lane clear.

## Loop skeleton

```js
let last = 0,
  running = false,
  paused = false,
  score = 0;
function frame(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05);
  last = now;
  if (running && !paused) {
    advance(dt);
    collide();
  }
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
function crash() {
  running = false;
  CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose", value: score });
}
```

Keep something moving on screen while idle (clouds, a pulsing prompt) so the run never looks frozen.

### Card `bridge`

# Bridge

Games talk to the host only through `postMessage`. Paste this helper verbatim before any game code:

```js
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
```

The helper must be named `CARTRIDGE` and must stamp `source: "cartridge"` and `v: 1` on every message. <!-- rule:E1-10 -->

## Game to host

| event   | payload                              | when                                 |
| ------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `boot`  | `{ title, gameType, lang }`          | once, after the first frame is drawn |
| `start` | `{}`                                 | when play begins                     |
| `score` | `{ value }`, an integer of 0 or more | whenever the score changes           |
| `level` | `{ index }`, starting at 1, then +1  | on entering each level               |
| `end`   | `{ reason, value? }`                 | once per play-through                |

- Send `boot` with all three keys: `CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title, gameType, lang })`. <!-- rule:E1-11 -->
- When `boot.lang` is written as a literal, it must equal the `lang` on `<html>`. <!-- rule:E1-12 -->
- Emit `CARTRIDGE.send("start")` when play begins. <!-- rule:E1-13 -->
- Write `boot.gameType` as a string literal naming one of the four game types; it must match the planned type. <!-- rule:E1-14 -->
- Pass `score.value` as a number, never a quoted string. <!-- rule:E1-18 -->
- Give every `level` call an `index` key: `CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage })`. <!-- rule:E1-19 -->

## Host to game

Commands arrive as `{ source: "cartridge-host", type }` with `type` one of `pause`, `resume` or `reset`. Ignore anything with another `source`.

- Listen with `window.addEventListener("message", …)` and handle `pause` and `resume`: freeze and restart the loop without losing state. <!-- rule:E1-20 -->
- Handle `reset` by returning to the pre-`start` screen without reloading the page. <!-- rule:E1-21 -->

```js
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});
```

### Card `game-page`

# Game page

A cartridge is one self-contained HTML file. The host loads it into a sandboxed iframe with scripts allowed and no same-origin access.

## Document

- Start with a single `<!doctype html>` and wrap everything in one `<html>…</html>`. Never embed another `<iframe>`. <!-- rule:E1-01 -->
- Put the UI language on the root element, for example `<html lang="fr">`: a two- or three-letter primary subtag with an optional region. <!-- rule:E1-03 -->
- Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` in the head. <!-- rule:E1-04 -->

## Self-contained

- Load nothing from outside the file: no `http:`, `https:` or `//` URL in `src`, `href`, CSS `url()`, `@import` or `import()`. Inline `data:` URIs are fine. <!-- rule:E1-02 -->
- Draw every sprite, tile and glyph in code (canvas paths or inline SVG). Use system fonts.

## Forbidden APIs

- Do not open a network connection: no `fetch(`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`, `EventSource` or `sendBeacon`. <!-- rule:E1-05 -->
- Do not persist anything: `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `indexedDB` and `document.cookie` all throw inside the sandbox. <!-- rule:E1-06 -->
- Do not build code at runtime: no `eval(`, no `new Function(`, and pass functions, not strings, to `setTimeout` and `setInterval`. <!-- rule:E1-07 -->
- Avoid blocking dialogs (`alert(`, `confirm(`, `prompt(`); draw messages on the canvas instead. <!-- rule:E1-08 -->

## Scripts

- Use classic inline `<script>` blocks only, never `type="module"`, and make sure each one parses on its own. <!-- rule:E1-09 -->
- Keep one script for the bridge helper and one for the game, or merge them. Order matters: the helper must exist first.

## Layout

- Fill the viewport and react when it changes: listen for `resize`, read `innerWidth`/`innerHeight`, or size with `dvh`/`vw` units. <!-- rule:E1-23 -->
- Scale the canvas by `devicePixelRatio` so lines stay crisp on phones.
- Keep touch targets at least 44 CSS pixels on the short edge.

### Card `paper-cut`

# Paper cut

Everything looks cut from coloured card and stacked in layers.

## Palette

| role       | colour    |
| ---------- | --------- |
| background | `#f4ecd8` |
| layer      | `#e07a5f` |
| accent     | `#3d405b` |
| highlight  | `#81b29a` |

## Primitives

- Filled paths with slightly irregular edges: jitter each vertex by one or two pixels, seeded once so it does not flicker.
- One soft shadow per layer: `shadowBlur` around 6 and a small downward offset.
- Rounded rectangles and circles for pieces; stacked copies offset by a few pixels suggest depth.
- Text in a heavy system sans-serif, drawn on a card-shaped plate.

## Avoid

- Gradients, glows and outlines thicker than two pixels.
- Pure black; use the accent colour for the darkest tone.
- Photographic textures or anything loaded from a file.

### Card `tap-anywhere`

# Tap anywhere

The whole screen is the button. Best for jumps, flaps and single choices.

- Register pointer input on the canvas: `canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", onTap)`. <!-- rule:E1-22 -->
- Call `event.preventDefault()` and set `touch-action: none` on the canvas so the page does not scroll or zoom.
- The first tap after `boot` starts play and sends `start`; later taps perform the action.
- Ignore taps while paused.

```js
canvas.style.touchAction = "none";
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (paused) return;
  if (!running) {
    running = true;
    CARTRIDGE.send("start");
    return;
  }
  act();
});
```

Show a short pulsing hint ("Tap to begin") until the first tap.

## Task

Write the complete game page for this plan and save it with `save_draft`.
I'll build the complete game page now.

input.html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Kite Over the Rooftops</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: #f4ecd8;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100dvh;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
  const CARTRIDGE = {
    send(type, payload = {}) {
      window.parent.postMessage(
        { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
        "*",
      );
    },
  };
</script>
<script>
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  let dpr = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
  let W = 0, H = 0;

  function resize() {
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    dpr = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    canvas.width = Math.floor(W * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(H * dpr);
    canvas.style.width = W + "px";
    canvas.style.height = H + "px";
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  // ---------- palette ----------
  const COL_BG = "#f4ecd8";
  const COL_LAYER = "#e07a5f";
  const COL_ACCENT = "#3d405b";
  const COL_HILITE = "#81b29a";

  // ---------- seeded jitter helpers ----------
  function seededRand(seed) {
    let s = seed % 2147483647;
    if (s <= 0) s += 2147483646;
    return function () {
      s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647;
      return (s - 1) / 2147483646;
    };
  }
  const jitterRand = seededRand(12345);
  function jitter(v, amt) {
    return v + (jitterRand() - 0.5) * amt * 2;
  }

  function roundedRectPath(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r, r);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h, r);
    ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r, r);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + r, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function jitterPolygon(points, seedOffset) {
    const rnd = seededRand(9000 + seedOffset);
    return points.map(([px, py]) => [
      px + (rnd() - 0.5) * 3,
      py + (rnd() - 0.5) * 3,
    ]);
  }

  function drawPaperShape(pathFn, fillColor, shadow) {
    ctx.save();
    if (shadow) {
      ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.35)";
      ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
      ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = fillColor;
    pathFn();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- game state ----------
  let last = 0;
  let running = false;
  let paused = false;
  let started = false; // whether boot happened
  let score = 0;
  let scoreSent = -1;
  let gameOverShown = false;

  let kiteY = 0;
  let kiteVY = 0;
  const kiteX = 0; // set relative to W
  let windSpeed = 160; // px/s scroll speed, ramps up
  let elapsed = 0;

  let chimneys = [];
  let ribbons = [];
  let clouds = [];
  let spawnTimer = 0;
  let ribbonTimer = 0;

  const GRAVITY = 480;
  const FLAP = -260;
  const KITE_R = 22;

  function initClouds() {
    clouds = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      clouds.push({
        x: Math.random() * 800,
        y: 40 + Math.random() * 150,
        s: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.8,
        speed: 20 + Math.random() * 20,
      });
    }
  }

  function resetGameState() {
    score = 0;
    scoreSent = -1;
    elapsed = 0;
    windSpeed = 160;
    kiteY = H / 2;
    kiteVY = 0;
    chimneys = [];
    ribbons = [];
    spawnTimer = 2.2; // fairness: keep opening lane clear a bit
    ribbonTimer = 1.2;
    gameOverShown = false;
    initClouds();
  }

  function backToTitle() {
    running = false;
    paused = false;
    resetGameState();
  }

  resetGameState();

  // ---------- spawning ----------
  function spawnChimney() {
    const gapH = Math.max(120, 230 - elapsed * 3);
    const margin = 60;
    const centerY = margin + Math.random() * (H - margin * 2 - gapH) + gapH / 2;
    chimneys.push({
      x: W + 60,
      w: 46,
      gapCenter: centerY,
      gapH: gapH,
      passed: false,
      seed: Math.floor(Math.random() * 10000),
    });
  }

  function spawnRibbon() {
    ribbons.push({
      x: W + 40,
      y: 60 + Math.random() * (H - 120),
      r: 12,
      taken: false,
      seed: Math.floor(Math.random() * 10000),
      bob: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
    });
  }

  // ---------- update ----------
  function advance(dt) {
    elapsed += dt;
    windSpeed = 160 + Math.min(elapsed * 4, 160); // ramps up to 320

    // clouds always drift for idle liveliness
    for (const c of clouds) {
      c.x -= c.speed * dt;
      if (c.x < -100) c.x = W + 100;
    }

    if (!running) return;

    kiteVY += GRAVITY * dt;
    kiteY += kiteVY * dt;

    if (kiteY < KITE_R) {
      kiteY = KITE_R;
      kiteVY = 0;
    }
    if (kiteY > H - KITE_R) {
      kiteY = H - KITE_R;
      kiteVY = 0;
    }

    spawnTimer -= dt;
    if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
      spawnChimney();
      spawnTimer = Math.max(1.1, 1.9 - elapsed * 0.01);
    }
    ribbonTimer -= dt;
    if (ribbonTimer <= 0) {
      spawnRibbon();
      ribbonTimer = 1.6 + Math.random() * 1.2;
    }

    for (const c of chimneys) {
      c.x -= windSpeed * dt;
    }
    for (const r of ribbons) {
      r.x -= windSpeed * dt;
      r.bob += dt * 3;
    }

    chimneys = chimneys.filter((c) => c.x > -c.w - 20);
    ribbons = ribbons.filter((r) => !r.taken && r.x > -40);

    // scoring: passing chimneys
    const kx = W * 0.28;
    for (const c of chimneys) {
      if (!c.passed && c.x + c.w < kx) {
        c.passed = true;
        score += 1;
      }
    }
    // ribbons collection
    for (const r of ribbons) {
      if (r.taken) continue;
      const dx = kx - r.x;
      const dy = kiteY - r.y;
      if (Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) < KITE_R + r.r) {
        r.taken = true;
        score += 3;
      }
    }

    if (score !== scoreSent) {
      scoreSent = score;
      CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: score });
    }
  }

  function collide() {
    if (!running) return;
    const kx = W * 0.28;
    for (const c of chimneys) {
      if (kx + KITE_R > c.x && kx - KITE_R < c.x + c.w) {
        const gapTop = c.gapCenter - c.gapH / 2;
        const gapBottom = c.gapCenter + c.gapH / 2;
        if (kiteY - KITE_R < gapTop || kiteY + KITE_R > gapBottom) {
          crash();
          return;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function crash() {
    running = false;
    gameOverShown = true;
    CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose", value: score });
  }

  // ---------- drawing ----------
  function drawBackground() {
    ctx.fillStyle = COL_BG;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // clouds - simple paper-cut puffs
    for (const c of clouds) {
      drawPaperShape(() => {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y, 30 * c.s, 16 * c.s, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.ellipse(c.x + 20 * c.s, c.y + 4 * c.s, 20 * c.s, 12 * c.s, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.ellipse(c.x - 20 * c.s, c.y + 4 * c.s, 18 * c.s, 11 * c.s, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      }, "#ffffff", false);
    }

    // rooftop skyline strip at bottom for depth
    drawPaperShape(() => {
      ctx.rect(0, H - 30, W, 30);
    }, COL_ACCENT, false);
  }

  function drawChimney(c) {
    const gapTop = c.gapCenter - c.gapH / 2;
    const gapBottom = c.gapCenter + c.gapH / 2;

    // top stack
    drawPaperShape(() => {
      const pts = jitterPolygon(
        [
          [c.x, -10],
          [c.x + c.w, -10],
          [c.x + c.w, gapTop],
          [c.x, gapTop],
        ],
        c.seed
      );
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]);
      for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]);
      ctx.closePath();
    }, COL_LAYER, true);

    // bottom stack
    drawPaperShape(() => {
      const pts = jitterPolygon(
        [
          [c.x, gapBottom],
          [c.x + c.w, gapBottom],
          [c.x + c.w, H + 10],
          [c.x, H + 10],
        ],
        c.seed + 1
      );
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]);
      for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]);
      ctx.closePath();
    }, COL_LAYER, true);

    // little chimney cap lines (accent bands)
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = COL_ACCENT;
    ctx.fillRect(c.x - 2, gapTop - 8, c.w + 4, 8);
    ctx.fillRect(c.x - 2, gapBottom, c.w + 4, 8);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawRibbon(r) {
    const bobY = r.y + Math.sin(r.bob) * 4;
    drawPaperShape(() => {
      const pts = jitterPolygon(
        [
          [r.x - 10, bobY - 4],
          [r.x + 10, bobY - 4],
          [r.x + 6, bobY + 10],
          [r.x, bobY + 4],
          [r.x - 6, bobY + 10],
        ],
        r.seed
      );
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]);
      for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]);
      ctx.closePath();
    }, COL_HILITE, true);
  }

  const kiteJitterSeed = 555;
  function drawKite(x, y) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    const tilt = Math.max(-0.4, Math.min(0.4, kiteVY / 900));
    ctx.rotate(tilt);

    // tail
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = COL_ACCENT;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-KITE_R * 0.6, KITE_R * 0.7);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-KITE_R * 1.6, KITE_R * 1.4, -KITE_R * 2.4, KITE_R * 0.9);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    // kite body - diamond paper cut
    drawPaperShape(() => {
      const pts = jitterPolygon(
        [
          [0, -KITE_R],
          [KITE_R * 0.85, 0],
          [0, KITE_R],
          [-KITE_R * 0.85, 0],
        ],
        kiteJitterSeed
      );
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]);
      for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]);
      ctx.closePath();
    }, COL_LAYER, true);

    // inner accent cross
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = COL_ACCENT;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -KITE_R);
    ctx.lineTo(0, KITE_R);
    ctx.moveTo(-KITE_R * 0.85, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(KITE_R * 0.85, 0);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawCardPlate(text, subtext, x, y, w, h) {
    drawPaperShape(() => {
      roundedRectPath(jitter(x, 1), jitter(y, 1), w, h, 14);
    }, "#fffaf0", true);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = COL_ACCENT;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "bold 26px -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(text, x + w / 2, y + h / 2 - (subtext ? 8 : -6));
    if (subtext) {
      ctx.font = "16px -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(subtext, x + w / 2, y + h / 2 + 20);
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  let hintPulse = 0;
  function draw() {
    drawBackground();

    for (const c of chimneys) drawChimney(c);
    for (const r of ribbons) if (!r.taken) drawRibbon(r);

    const kx = W * 0.28;
    drawKite(kx, kiteY);

    // score plate top-left
    const plateW = 120, plateH = 46;
    drawPaperShape(() => {
      roundedRectPath(14, 14, plateW, plateH, 10);
    }, "#fffaf0", true);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = COL_ACCENT;
    ctx.font = "bold 20px -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillText("Ribbons: " + score, 26, 14 + plateH / 2 + 7);
    ctx.restore();

    if (!running) {
      hintPulse += 0.05;
      const alpha = 0.6 + Math.sin(hintPulse) * 0.4;
      const w = Math.min(320, W * 0.8);
      const h = 110;
      const x = W / 2 - w / 2;
      const y = H / 2 - h / 2;
      if (gameOverShown) {
        drawCardPlate("Flight Over", "Ribbons collected: " + score + " — tap to fly again", x, y, w, h);
      } else {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
        drawCardPlate("Tap to begin", "Ride the wind, dodge the chimneys", x, y, w, h);
        ctx.restore();
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------- input ----------
  canvas.style.touchAction = "none";
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (paused) return;
    if (!running) {
      if (gameOverShown) {
        resetGameState();
      }
      running = true;
      CARTRIDGE.send("start");
      return;
    }
    act();
  });

  function act() {
    kiteVY = FLAP;
  }

  // ---------- host messages ----------
  window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
    const data = event.data;
    if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
    if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
    if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
    if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
  });

  // ---------- main loop ----------
  function frame(now) {
    const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05);
    last = now;
    if (running && !paused) {
      advance(dt);
      collide();
    } else if (!paused) {
      // idle animation for clouds even before start
      advance(Math.min(dt, 0.05));
    }
    draw();
    if (!started) {
      started = true;
      CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title: "Kite Over the Rooftops", gameType: "arcade-run", lang: "en" });
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame((t) => {
    last = t;
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
